installs mysql-client-core-8.0 on the peer if absent; makes three TCP logins from the peer to the class node's port 3306 (the server logs nothing for them beyond its counters); the answers go to /run/p8test-mysqldb-peer/answers.txt

the database exists with the utf8mb3 charset and collation

the rw account logs in over TLS with its password and writes; the ro account logs in over TLS and reads, and its write is refused
another host logs in over the network with TLS, and without TLS is refused
